name: Shri Chintamani Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Chinchwad Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Theur's Chintamani Ganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. The default Astavinayak pilgrim bed for Theur.
